name: v0.5.0 starter
notes: Hermetic warm-up tasks that need no network and no clone. The 30-task release run adds repo/commit tasks alongside these; see docs/agent-evaluation.md.

tasks.prompt: chunk() in textkit/chunker.py drops the final partial chunk. Fix it so every element appears exactly once, then make sure the tests pass.
tasks.regression_verify: python3 -c "import textkit.chunker as c; assert c.chunk([], 3) == []"

tasks.prompt: parse_duration() in textkit/duration.py raises on an empty string instead of returning 0. Fix it and keep the existing behavior for valid input.
tasks.regression_verify: python3 -c "import textkit.duration as d; assert d.parse_duration('2m') == 120"

tasks.prompt: Add a `dedupe` function to textkit/lists.py that removes duplicates while preserving order, and make the tests in test_lists.py pass.
tasks.regression_verify: python3 -c "import textkit.lists as l; assert l.flatten([[1],[2]]) == [1, 2]"
